body: Quick pass: the PR merges cleanly with `main`. The author reports the 6 `cli_options_tests` and clippy on `camcraft-ui` green on this head. The body is complete. I flag the PR ready for the independent review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c7cb24ec2da9b5e8a05ae4274912f7ecfa497fd0 -->

Review of head c7cb24ec2. The head merges cleanly with current main. I built and ran it on Windows.

**What I ran**

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 866 passed, 6 ignored. The six new `cli_options` tests passed. They pin the table, the help text and the parser.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test egui_app`: 3 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test shell`: 21 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Completeness check**

- The parser, the table and the help text agree on all seven options. Each reader flag (`--ui`, `--headless`, `--gpu`, `--gpu-backend`, `--mcp-port`) is in the table. The help lists no option that the parser rejects.
- I checked every environment read in the startup path. The eight listed variables are real reads. I also found `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU`: only `device_for_test` reads it, and only the lane tests call it. I also found `CAMCRAFT_CARRY_ENGINE`: `CARRY_ENGINE_SWITCH_HONOURED` shows a release build never reads it. The decision file gives both exclusions, and both are true.
- One variable is read in all builds but not listed and not in the exclusion note: `CAMCRAFT_PROFILE_PROJECTION` (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/slice.rs:51`).

**Findings**

1. Blocker: `--ui=value` is accepted but ignored. `cli_options::parse` handles the `=` form for each option that takes a value (`crates/ui/src/cli_options.rs:160`). The `--ui` reader at `crates/ui/src/lib.rs:129` matches only the token `--ui`. So `camcraft-ui --ui=imgui` now starts the app. A space value gets the named refusal with code 2, as the law from M-g requires. The test in `crates/ui/tests/egui_app.rs` uses the space form only. The help text says a value can follow in either form. That line is not true for `--ui`. Fix: read the `--ui` value with a helper that takes both forms. Add a pin test for `--ui=imgui` with code 2.
2. Minor: the help gives `--gpu-backend <dx12|metal|vulkan|gl>`. `parse_backend` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/gpu.rs:37`) also accepts `d3d12`, `gles` and `opengl`. List the synonyms in the help, or narrow the parser.
3. Minor: add `CAMCRAFT_PROFILE_PROJECTION` to the decision file's exclusion note, or to the help. It is a developer timing switch, so an exclusion note fits.

**Law checks**

- No snapshot PNG in the diff. No `unwrap` or `expect` on a shipped path; the test uses are fine.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line. The commit is conventional and names the issue. The help text and the guide page are plain English.

Verdict: needs-rework. One blocker. The table design and the test pins are good; a small fix to the `--ui` reader should close it.

effort:medium (crates/ui, known pattern) · not escalated. ui lib and egui_app test binaries built and run at -j 6; clippy clean. One blocker found in the --ui option reader.

Review fix pushed, head a4e3f1005. The PR stays a draft.

1. Blocker fixed. The `--ui` reader in `crates/ui/src/lib.rs` now takes `--ui value` and `--ui=value`. Both forms give the same result. An unknown or empty value is refused by name with code 2. Pin test: `ui_equals_form_refuses_like_the_space_form` in `crates/ui/tests/egui_app.rs`.
2. Minor fixed. The `--gpu-backend` help now names the synonyms `d3d12`, `gles` and `opengl`. The parser is not narrowed, so scripts that use them keep working.
3. Minor fixed. `CAMCRAFT_PROFILE_PROJECTION` is in the exclusion note of `docs/decisions/2082-help-options.md` as a developer timing switch.

Tests: the new pin, `cli_options` lib tests (6), `egui_app` (4) and `shell` (21) pass. Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` is clean.

Not done: I did not merge `origin/main` into the branch. Main does not compile for `camcraft-ui` now: `crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:43` does not cover `Kind::Waterjet` (E0004). This is not part of this PR.
